tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background of the app shell and marketing site.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, side panels on top of paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind the resume canvas and input fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The resume canvas. Always paper-white in BOTH themes: users must see what the recruiter sees.

tokens.name: sheet-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sheet only. Never used in the app shell.

tokens.name: sheet-line
tokens.usage: Rules and dividers drawn inside the resume canvas.

tokens.name: highlighter
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Means "this changed". Background behind changed text and the wordmark stroke; never a text colour.

tokens.name: highlighter-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tint for changed-state rows and the hero ground behind a highlight.

tokens.name: on-highlighter
tokens.usage: Text on a highlighter or highlighter-soft (light) fill. 13:1 on highlighter.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Sourced / confirmed. Source tags and verified badges; as text on paper, paper-raised and verified-soft.

tokens.name: verified-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind verified text.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Something is missing or needs the user. Gap prompts and warnings; as text on paper, paper-raised and gap-soft. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: gap-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind gap text.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Ink in light, highlighter in dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an action fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on paper and paper-raised. Always underlined.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (3:1+ on every surface in both themes).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Literata (Google Fonts). Headlines only; never for UI controls.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Your resume. Tailored to every job.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers on the marketing site.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Hind (Indian Type Foundry, Google Fonts). All interface and reading text.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We changed 6 lines. We added nothing you didn't do.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Upload your resume once. Share any job to tailor it.
styles.usage: Default UI and reading text. Never below 16px for paragraphs on phones.

groups.name: Evidence
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono marks anything that is proof: sources, file facts, parse output.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels. The only uppercase text in the product.

spacing.note: 4px base. Phone gutters are space-4; desktop gutters space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small controls; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop gutters, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on the marketing site.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding on desktop.

radius.note: Document-like: small radii, never bubbly. Pills only for chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Highlights, source tags, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, pass cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The resume canvas: it is paper, nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips only.

shadow.note: Only two things float: the resume sheet and bottom sheets/menus. Everything else uses a line border.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The resume canvas lifting off paper-sunken.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, menus, the extension side panel.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px paper gap, then 2px solid focus colour.
